about: scripts/perf-guard.py, live part: haxeon run --watch --live on tests/perf/live-project (small) and on the app template over haxeon-ui (ui), from the save of an edit to the running app's patch-applied event, with the CLI and server built ahead of time (haxeon-aot, aot_). Measured on Linux x86-64. Tolerances are fractions of the value (tolerance) or counts (tolerance_abs).

aot_small_body_edit_ms.why: Median save-to-applied wall of a body edit of the small program. Wall varies with the machine's load, so only a wait added on the edit's path (a poll, a write, a collection, work left from the last request) fails it.

aot_small_signature_edit_ms.why: Save-to-applied wall of a changed static signature in the small program, which recompiles its callers and patches an adapter in; loose for the same reason.

aot_ui_body_edit_ms.why: Median save-to-applied wall of a body edit of the UI app, whose program is mostly haxeon-ui. Wall varies with the machine's load, so only a wait added on the edit's path (a poll, a write, a collection, work left from the last request) fails it.

aot_ui_signature_edit_ms.why: Save-to-applied wall of a changed static signature in the UI app, whose program is mostly haxeon-ui, which recompiles its callers and patches an adapter in; loose for the same reason.

small_body_edit_functions.why: The functions the body edit's patch carries, which the runtime compiles: the edited one and what it is inlined into. Deterministic.

small_signature_edit_functions.why: The edited function, its callers and the adapter: deterministic.

ui_body_edit_functions.why: The functions the body edit's patch carries, which the runtime compiles: the edited one and what it is inlined into. Deterministic.

ui_signature_edit_functions.why: The edited function, its callers and the adapter: deterministic.

aot_small_server_live_bytes.why: The server's live data after the growth session's last edit (a full collection ends each build): what a live session keeps.
aot_small_server_live_bytes.raise_reason: The baseline was measured on a tree without recorded reads: at its own commit 0d4357594 the small session measures 33.3 MB on this machine. Since then two 1 MiB steps, bisected with the small growth session on the VM server: b62b5a39c (strict null safety in compiler.ir.passes.arrays, most likely its value-array accessor records, which now keep their names; not traced to one structure) 48.3 -> 49.4 MB, and 5ac1f3be1 (purity inference keeps each function's dependencies with the declaration facts it read, which a body edit reuses) 49.4 -> 50.5 MB. 540848a15 (recorded reads) itself lowered it, 63.4 -> 62.3 MB. Releasing the IR of the functions a live patch drops does not change it: the small session's edits drop none.

aot_small_server_live_growth_bytes.why: Live data growth over the growth session's edits after those that fill the session. A live session must keep about what a plain one keeps; growth here is history kept per revision. The slack absorbs the collector's page rounding.

aot_ui_server_live_bytes.why: The server's live data after the growth session's last edit (a full collection ends each build): what a live session keeps.
aot_ui_server_live_bytes.raise_reason: The baseline was measured on a tree without recorded reads: at its own commit 0d4357594 the ui session measures 971.7 MB on this machine. 540848a15 (typed units invalidated by what they recorded reading; the session keeps each unit's reads and each fact's print) adds 67.6 MB on the VM server, 1049.0 -> 1116.7 MB. Since 0d4357594 the VM server's figure fell 25 MB (991.1 MB there, 966.4 MB at e015e48d4), and 3d3bed2c6 (the inliner keeps what it made of each function with what it read of its callees) adds 7.5 MB (973.9 MB).

aot_ui_server_live_growth_bytes.why: Live data growth over the growth session's edits after those that fill the session. A live session must keep about what a plain one keeps; growth here is history kept per revision. The slack absorbs the collector's page rounding.
aot_ui_server_live_growth_bytes.raise_reason: A heap census of the ui growth session's builds 6 and 11 (VM server) is flat now that a live patch lets go of the IR of the functions it drops: -0.1 MB, no IrFunction or IrBlock added, where e015e48d4 adds 6.2 MB, 8,205 IrBlocks and 515 IrBodies of dropped functions decoded each build. The metric is the collector's footprint after a full collection, which moves by about 10 MB between runs on this machine: +4.3 MB at 0d4357594, +11.8 MB at e015e48d4, +6.4 MB and this +4.3 MB with the dropped functions released.
